authorization.scope: Source-bound investigation of the assigned public dice-duel issue; no production or real-value interaction.

property.statement: A participant who assembles a game must not be able to select the winner before both wagers are committed.
property.protectedOutcome: Neither player can preselect a favorable dice-duel winner from public, caller-controlled inputs.

evidence.claim: The pinned contract accepts caller-supplied session_id and later derives the dice seed from session_id and the two player addresses; roll only records flags.
The public update reports session_id 1 producing player 1 as winner and session_id 3 producing player 2 as winner for the same players and wagers.
The public update reports that reversing roll order and changing roll ledgers did not change the deterministic outcome.
A test-only commitment prototype was reported at 344 preimage bytes, 193499 maximum CPU instructions, 42820 maximum memory bytes, and a three-entry 500-byte maximum write footprint.
The investigation asks the maintainer for the official Game Hub ABI or permission for a neutral cancel_game terminal path.

finding.claim: An actor able to choose session_id can search candidate IDs before game creation and select a favorable deterministic winner.
finding.rootCause: The outcome seed contains only values known before betting, including caller-controlled session_id; roll contributes no hidden entropy.
finding.searchBound: Two reported session IDs plus roll-order and ledger-variation negative controls; the full harness corpus is not archived.

blockers.question: Provide the official Game Hub ABI or authorize an additive cancel_game(session_id) path for the neither-reveals terminal state.

impact.protectedOutcome: Fair and value-conserving settlement of a two-player wager.
impact.statement: A participant who controls session_id can plausibly choose a favorable deterministic winner before both wagers are finalized, undermining economic fairness and trust. No realized monetary loss or affected population has been measured.
